blocks.text: Confirmed messages, pending sends and ephemeral signals live in separate structures. Message is the server record; a pending send has the same shape with a null sequence. ConversationSummary drives the inbox, and ThreadState keeps the older-page cursor and the member's read marker.

blocks.title: Signals that never persist
blocks.text: Typing and presence signals expire quickly and stay out of storage. Drafts persist per conversation in the browser only until they are sent. Message bodies render as text, with links detected and escaped, so a crafted message cannot inject markup into another member's inbox.
